text:
elaine_sales: FYI Orchid Retail escalated to execs this morning. They require BYO-KMS (HSM preferred) and a hard throughput commitment for peak promo windows. Finance also asked for a capex purchase path. Can infra + legal pick this up? cc @sam_solutions @deepak_eng @karen_legal @jamie_se

sam_solutions: I can coordinate infra. Need their traffic curve and SLOs. Is peak TPS sustained or spiky?

elaine_sales: Customer doc says peak ~12k req/min for ~20min bursts during promos, baseline ~3k. Target p95 <=150ms. I'll upload the export to the calendar invite.

deepak_eng: Quick tech take: with warmed KV cache we handle ~10k steady. For 12k bursts we can do either (A) reserved burst pool sized for 3k extra or (B) aggressive autoscale with warm standby. Option A simpler for SLOs, Option B cheaper on avg. HSM/BYO-KMS requires VPC peering/private deployment path 1-28 day lead.

karen_legal: CISO wants explicit key custody language + audit log retention. I'll draft a DPA addendum for BYO-KMS, include rotation attestation and admin access matrix. Which KMS vendors are they considering?

jamie_se: Pricing: capex path doable for a committed reserved pool. I can build a 12/24 month amortized capex model if I get delta $/month between reserved vs burst.

maria_prod: Scheduling a 30-min bridge with their infra/CISO + our infra/legal at 3:30pm PT. Sending invite now.

sam_solutions: Deepak 1 please post a one-page ops note by 1:30pm with: assumptions, two capacity options, timeline for HSM, and quick cost delta. I'll convert to a short slide for execs.

deepak_eng: On it. Will include sample qps curve and cache-warm recommendations. ETA 1:00pm.

ops_bot: Ticket created INC-41899 - "Orchid Retail exec escalation: BYO-KMS + throughput". Oncall: infra-team.

elaine_sales: Action items recap: (1) deepak - ops note + numbers by 1pm, (2) sam - exec slide + cost delta, (3) karen - DPA addendum draft, (4) jamie - capex model template pending cost delta, (5) maria - host 3:30pm sync. Please update thread after you post artifacts. :thumbsup:
